violated_contract: A session outcome counter must be recorded from the session's observed speech and transcript state even when a later cleanup or health callback fails. A callback exception must not erase telemetry for completed work or leak the admission slot.
canonical_prevention: Record the bounded session outcome idempotently before invoking external cleanup callbacks, and release admission in a finally path. Exercise real admission and session teardown, and make a cleanup callback fail in a regression test to prove both the outcome counter and slot release still occur.
